## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `claude plugin test agent-office` (if the mod changed)
- [ ] `cd e2e && npm test` (if the page or the bridge changed)
- [ ] Tried it in a browser (screenshot below, if it shows)

## Before merging

- [ ] Changes under `agent-office/`, `visualizer/src/` or `.claude-plugin/` bump the version (`node scripts/version.mjs set <version>`) with a `CHANGELOG.md` section
- [ ] Nothing in the [stability policy](https://github.com/tharun-se95/ModsArena/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md#stability) changes, or this is a major version
